name: generate-changelog
description: Generate full CHANGELOG.md from git history
script:
cd /workspace && git log --pretty=format:'%h %s' --reverse | awk '{hash=$1; $1=""; print "- " $0 " (" hash ")"}' > CHANGELOG.md && sed -i '1i# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
' CHANGELOG.md && echo "CHANGELOG.md generated from git history"
